plan.title: Forward auction auto title for three products

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen from the Create Event flow.
Switch the event type to Auction using the supported auction configuration controls.
Choose the first available auction pricing template so the product sheet is available.
Add three line-item rows, the closest supported approximation to the requested three products.
